en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a large, ornate school building on a tree‑lined waterfront. In the foreground, a calm body of water with a rowboat carrying two people; behind it, a promenade with trees and the imposing multi‑storey brick or stone structure with a hipped roof, dormers, and a small tower. Surrounding the main building are residential houses. At the top of the postcard there is printed text indicating the location and the name of the school.
